name: OmniCap-IF
abstract: OmniCap-IF evaluates instruction following in omni-modal captioning. This page uses the Overall CSR from the main table.
method: This work extends instruction following to omni-modal video captioning, requiring models to satisfy format, content, and cross-modal constraints together.
It argues that omni captioning should evaluate not only generation quality, but also whether complex instructions are truly followed.
The main results show stronger overall performance from leading closed-source omni models, while open-source omni models are becoming competitive.
